title: Resolution/Bandwidth/Route Retype of the E010 Multicorridor Threshold
status: SOURCE-SEMANTIC RETYPE + FINITE ROUTE-READINESS TEST; NOT PHYSICAL DARK-MATTER WITNESS
ruling: E010 B is allocated corridor capacity, not source Bandwidth itself.
All 148 robust pairs are unresolved at coarse R0 but become distinguishable at adjacency Resolution R1, changing 8 or 10 of the 12 labeled edge relations.
All 296 representative robust states possess at least one optimal two-corridor selection that is geometrically composable into a local path.
Only 16/296 states force every tested optimal B2 selection to be path-connected; therefore multicorridor survival creates route capacity but does not automatically instantiate Rainbow Road.
